scenarios.prompt: An earned wallet and premium wallet receive grants, spends and a conversion. Define a stable ledger and idempotent transaction IDs.

criteria.ledger: Wallet IDs, signed deltas, reasons and transaction IDs reconcile displayed balances.
criteria.idempotency: Duplicate grants/spends/refunds/conversions do not apply twice.
criteria.evidence: Insufficient balance, duplicate callback and atomic conversion failure are tested.
